escalation: Monthly base rent increases by $300/month on the second anniversary of the Commencement Date, and by an additional $300/month on each anniversary thereafter for the remainder of the term
cam: Tenant contributes toward shared building costs, amount determined by Landlord from time to time, consistent with comparable properties - no fixed percentage or dollar figure given
renewal_option: One 5-year option, written notice required at a commercially reasonable time before expiration - no specific day count given
